##### Project general facts

The Amani Melasti project represents an exceptional upscale boutique hotel concept created for modern travelers and investors who appreciate refined hospitality and premium design. The development features a limited collection of just ninety thoughtfully designed rooms and apartments, with sizes ranging from compact elegant studios to spacious residences with spectacular sunset ocean views or direct access to private pools. This exclusive format ensures a sense of privacy and boutique charm while maintaining the standards of an international resort destination. 

Amani Melasti offers an impressive collection of lifestyle and wellness amenities designed to create a complete resort experience. Guests can enjoy a stunning rooftop infinity pool overlooking the ocean, a stylish cocktail bar, and panoramic sunset terraces that capture the magic of Bali’s coastline. The hotel also features a refined restaurant serving gourmet cuisine, a professional spa center dedicated to relaxation and rejuvenation, and elegant lounge spaces designed for both leisure and productivity. A dedicated coworking space allows guests to combine travel with work effortlessly, while a full concierge service ensures that every request — from transfers to private excursions — is handled with exceptional care. Every facility is thoughtfully designed to transform a stay into an immersive lifestyle experience.

The interiors embody sophisticated minimalism enriched with refined Balinese boho elements, creating a calm and elegant atmosphere that reflects the spirit of the island. Each residence is designed as a sanctuary of comfort, where natural textures, warm tones, and high-quality materials blend seamlessly with contemporary architectural aesthetics. The rooms are equipped with premium furniture, thoughtfully designed kitchen areas, and carefully selected decorative elements that enhance both functionality and beauty. Special attention is given to comfort and relaxation, including soundproofing, adjustable lighting, and modern technologies that support restful sleep and a rejuvenating stay. Every detail contributes to a refined living environment where guests can fully unwind and enjoy the serene rhythm of Bali.

##### Parking 
Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Located in one of Bali’s most prestigious coastal areas on the Bukit Peninsula, the surrounding location is renowned for its breathtaking ocean views, dramatic cliffs, and world-class beaches. The area is home to one of the most picturesque beaches on the island, famous for its white sand, crystal-clear turquoise waters, and spectacular sunsets that attract travelers from around the world. The coastline enjoys a warm tropical climate with abundant sunshine throughout the year, creating ideal conditions for relaxation, beach leisure, and outdoor experiences.

The district is considered one of the most desirable destinations for high-end tourism, offering a sophisticated atmosphere combined with natural beauty. Visitors are surrounded by an exceptional selection of beach clubs, fine dining restaurants, luxury resorts, cultural landmarks, and scenic viewpoints. The area is also known for its vibrant lifestyle scene, where daytime relaxation seamlessly transforms into sunset gatherings and elegant evening entertainment.

In addition to its natural charm, the location benefits from developed infrastructure and convenient accessibility to key attractions across southern Bali. Internationally renowned beach clubs, cultural sites, golf courses, shopping areas, and the island’s main airport are all within comfortable reach. This unique combination of accessibility, prestige, and natural beauty has established the area as one of the most sought-after destinations for premium hospitality and leisure in Bali.
